case_results.question: How much does the Team plan cost per month?
case_results.answer: The Team plan costs $449 per month [pricing:0 — Plans and billing].

case_results.question: How many seats does the Launch plan include?
case_results.answer: The Launch plan includes 4 seats [pricing:0 — Plans and billing].

case_results.question: What is the maximum number of run records accepted in a single POST /v2/runs request?
case_results.answer: The maximum number of run records accepted in a single POST /v2/runs request is 400 [ingest:0 — Run ingestion API].

case_results.question: What HTTP status code does the ingestion API return for an oversized request?
case_results.answer: The ingestion API returns HTTP status code 413 for an oversized request [ingest:0 — Run ingestion API].

case_results.question: For how long are duplicate submissions with the same event_id suppressed?
case_results.answer: Duplicate submissions with the same event_id are suppressed for 48 hours [ingest:2 — Run ingestion API].

case_results.question: How often do Signals alert rules evaluate workflow metrics?
case_results.answer: Signals alert rules evaluate workflow metrics every 4 minutes [alerts:0 — Signals alert rules].

case_results.question: What does the SDK do when its in-memory buffer is full?
case_results.answer: When the SDK's in-memory buffer is full, the oldest unsent record is dropped and a warning is logged [sdk:1 — SDK integration guide].

case_results.question: How long should an application allow for the SDK flush during graceful shutdown?
case_results.answer: An application should allow up to 10 seconds for the SDK flush to complete during graceful shutdown [sdk:2 — SDK integration guide].

case_results.question: How many days of history does seasonal anomaly alerting require?
case_results.answer: Seasonal anomaly alerting requires 21 complete days of history [onboarding:1 — Customer onboarding guide] [alerts:0 — Signals alert rules] [incident-03:2 — INC-2026-03 delayed alerts].

case_results.question: Which warehouses does Warehouse Export support on the Team plan?
case_results.answer: On the Team plan, Warehouse Export supports BigQuery and Snowflake [export:0 — Warehouse Export specification].

case_results.question: What monthly uptime percentage does the Enterprise SLA commit to?
case_results.answer: The Enterprise SLA commits to a contractual monthly uptime of 99.92% [sla:0 — Service and support terms].

case_results.question: Which city hosts the EU region?
case_results.answer: Dublin hosts the EU region [regions:0 — Regions and workspace setup].

case_results.question: What is the maximum number of rows an AQL query can return?
case_results.answer: An AQL query can return at most 8000 rows [query:0 — AQL query reference].

case_results.question: Can a Launch workspace buy extra seats?
case_results.answer: No, a Launch workspace cannot buy extra seats [pricing:1 — Plans and billing].

case_results.question: Which plans include Run Explorer, and how long are timelines kept on each?
case_results.answer: Run Explorer is included on the Team and Enterprise plans, and it is unavailable on the Launch plan [traces:0 — Run Explorer specification]. Timelines are kept for 14 days on the Team plan and 60 days on the Enterprise plan [release-22:1 — Version 2.2 release notes] [traces:1 — Run Explorer specification].

case_results.question: Which patch fixed the duplicate warehouse rows, and what is the idempotency key it introduced?
case_results.answer: Patch 2.1.2 fixed the duplicate warehouse rows [release-21:2 — Version 2.1 release notes] [incident-12:1 — INC-2025-12 duplicate exports]. The idempotency key it introduced is the pair (export_job_id, record_hash) [release-21:2 — Version 2.1 release notes] [export:1 — Warehouse Export specification].

case_results.question: Which incident led to the monotonic scheduler clock, and in which patch was it fixed?
case_results.answer: Incident INC-2026-03 led to the adoption of the monotonic scheduler clock, and it was fixed in Patch 2.3.1 [release-23:1 — Version 2.3 release notes] [incident-03:1 — INC-2026-03 delayed alerts] [alerts:2 — Signals alert rules].

case_results.question: On the Launch plan, how long are run records searchable and how many alert rules can a project have?
case_results.answer: On the Launch plan, searchable run records are retained for 21 days [pricing:1 — Plans and billing], and a project can have 6 alert rules [pricing:2 — Plans and billing] [alerts:1 — Signals alert rules].
